# GimbalSpeedControl (command)

Gimbal SpeedControl. THIS is the command the real app actually uses for interactive single-pilot gimbal control - confirmed 2026-10-24 against dji.pilot's real FPV gimbal UI (DJIFpvGimbalPitchView.java): sent continuously on a 40ms timer while a control button is held (permission bit + speed), then one final permission-release + zero-speed send on release. An exhaustive call-site search of the whole decompiled app found AngleControl/AbsAngleControl/Control/ RcRequestGimbalCtrPermission used only for RC master/slave handoff and the third-party Mobile SDK layer - NOT this app's own gimbal control path.

**Confidence:** V

**Provenance:** dji.pilot decompile, DataGimbalSpeedControl.java + DJIFpvGimbalPitchView.java. Permission is embedded as bit7 of the flags byte in THIS SAME packet - there is no separate request/ack handshake for interactive control (RcRequestGimbalCtrPermission, 0x06/0x22, appears to be for the master/slave scenario, not this flow - matches it never getting a reply). speedDegPerSec scale is I (inferred) - deg/s*10 by analogy with this project's existing *10 convention; the UI's own speed constant is a raw 270, not independently confirmed as a unit. Was app/awto_dji_app/lib/link/gimbal_commands.dart's `speedControl()` and scripts/re/duml_commands.py's `GimbalSpeedControl`/`gimbal.speedControl`.
